mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may increase gastrointestinal toxicity and bleeding risk; chlorpromazine may enhance CNS depression and lower seizure threshold; both drugs can affect renal perfusion and increase nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor for GI symptoms, bleeding signs, and renal function; use lowest effective NSAID dose with gastroprotection if necessary; educate patient on CNS depression effects and fall risk.
